ITA-1.9.4.3.1 ātmaguṇaḥ आत्मगुणः
Qualities of the self
The six attributes of the self (atmaः intelligence (buddhi), pleasure (sukha), sorrow (duḥkha), desire (iccha), aversion (dvesha) and effort (prayatna).

ITA-1.9.3.2.1 ātmā आत्मा
Self
Soul, the principle of life and sensation, the individual self, the conscious element in the human body.
